title: A Simple and Rapid Agarose Gel Electrophoresis Method to Assess CpG Methylation of DNA
author: Marco Paliza-Carre

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: Open TotalLab CLIQS gel analysis software and open the gel image file.

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: Generate a new analysis protocol with the following settings. Check box “Invert Image Intensity” Rolling Ball: 200 Minimum: 1 Noise reduction: 5 %Max Peak: 1 Maximum peak of the: Gel Edges: Automatic Detection

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: On the gel image, select a minimal area of interest (AOI) that contains all bands of ladders and samples.

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: Run the protocol you generated above.

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: Confirm that lanes were accurately generated, and bands were accurately defined.

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: Set up Rf calibration

steps_raw.title: Quantitation of gel bands
steps_raw.instruction: Open the “Rf Calibration” tab. Select keep Rf lines aligned with no lane. Deselect “Use curved Rf lines”. Select “Snap Rf lines to Bands when dragging”. Drag the points from the 0 Rf line to the top 20,000 bp band of each ladder. Drag the points from the 1 Rf line to the bottom 75 bp band of each ladder. Delete any extra points that are not snapped to the top or bottom ladder bands and ensure that top Rf line is still labeled 0.000 and bottom Rf line is still labeled 1.000.

steps_raw.title: Calculation of mRf and intermediate/total
steps_raw.instruction: Select the relevant lane or “all lanes” tab at the bottom of the window.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Ensure that none of the bands intended for analysis are oversaturated.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Image using gel documentation system with blue light. Use a 400-millisecond exposure time - this may need to be optimized if a different system is used.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Cover gel to protect from light and stain in staining solution 1 hr at 150 rpm on shaker.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Make a solution of 1x SYBR Safe in 150 mL 1x TAE.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Run gel at 100V (6.7 volts/centimeter) for 100 minutes.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Load 100 ng of sample or 300 ng of GeneRuler 1 kb+ ladder per lane. The wells should be 3 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick well. Ensure that ladders flank the sample(s).

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare 900 mL of 1x TAE running buffer.

steps_raw.title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis, staining, and imaging
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare a 0.5 cm thick 1.5% agarose gel.

steps_raw.title: Restriction Enzyme Digest
steps_raw.instruction: Add 10 µL of 6x TriTrack DNA loading dye and 3.16 µL of 10% SDS to each reaction.

steps_raw.title: Restriction Enzyme Digest
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate in 37°C water bath for 1 hr.

steps_raw.title: Restriction Enzyme Digest
steps_raw.instruction: Quick spin in microcentrifuge up to 8000 rpm/6000 g.

steps_raw.title: Restriction Enzyme Digest
steps_raw.instruction: Invert 10 times to mix.

steps_raw.title: Restriction Enzyme Digest
steps_raw.instruction: Add reagents to 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes as listed below.

steps_raw.title: Restriction Enzyme Digest
steps_raw.instruction: Digest 1 µg of DNA per 50 µL reaction.
